subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "I've got GPA-5 in the SSC Examination," said Samir. "Congratulations, brother!" I said. "What do you intend to do now?" "I wish to study science group in a reputed college. I've a mind to get admission in BUET after my HSC," Samir replied.
guide_solution: Samir told me that he (R) had got GPA 5 in the SSC examination. Addressing him as brother I congratulated him and asked him what he intended to do then. Samir replied that he wanted to study science group in a reputed college. He added that he had a mind to get admission in BUET after his HSC.
